## What's new

- **Strip & share as file.** A new share option that sends the clean copy as a document, so WhatsApp and other chat apps don't compress it.
- **Clearer results.** The photo details sheet now separates what was removed from what was kept at a glance.
- Smoother option chips on the home screen, and content no longer scrolls under the status bar.

## Download

Get **`exif-remover-v1.2.0.apk`**. One file for every phone, Android 11 or newer.
